qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Near-monopoly ISO regulatory statistical reporting and Xactimate claims estimation standards command 4-6% annual pricing power with >95% customer retention, generating ~36% GAAP ROIC and ~54% EBITDA margins.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Irreplaceable US P&C insurance regulatory and claims toll booth with near-monopoly ISO loss-cost data and ubiquitous Xactimate estimating software. High pricing power demonstrated by consistent 4-6% annual contract escalators with >95% retention. Pure-play focus post-Wood Mackenzie divestiture expanded GAAP ROIC to ~36% and FCF conversion to >100%. Fortress balance sheet with net debt under 3x earnings after redeeming the AccuLynx transaction debt. [5-10Y g: organic volume/upsell 4.0% + price 3.0% + margin expansion 0.5% + net share repurchases 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year GAAP ROIC expanded from 13.2% in FY16 to 35.9% in FY25 following the disciplined divestiture of non-core energy (Wood Mackenzie for $3.1B) and financial services units. FY25 revenue reached $3,072.7M with EBIT of $1,343.9M (43.7% EBIT margin) and Owner FCF of $1,137.7M (125% conversion of $908.3M net income). Unassailable industry position as licensed statistical agent in all 50 states for insurance rate filings, with Xactimate creating a two-sided standard across carriers and adjusters. Balance sheet is sound with Net Debt / NI of 2.86x ($2,595M net debt vs $908M NI) and EBIT interest coverage of 7.86x; FY25 gross debt spike was temporary due to escrowed notes for the AccuLynx deal, which were redeemed upon transaction termination in Jan 2026.
